page_title: VEN 0-2 ACM | Venezia v AC Milan 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 0 - 2 Goal! Tijjani Reijnders gets to the ball, slips Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:2.
90+5' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+5' Kike Perez (Venezia) will take a corner kick.

90+4' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jay Idzes (Venezia) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Mike Maignan. What a save!
90+4' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
90+3' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) brings his opponent down. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes a short free kick.

90+1' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Venezia win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' That was close by Alessio Zerbin (Venezia)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
88' Sergio Conceicao has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) replacing Youssouf Fofana.
88' Substitution. Joao Felix (AC Milan) in, Christian Pulisic out.
86' Kike Perez (Venezia) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
86' John Yeboah (Venezia) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
82' The resulting corner from Kike Perez (Venezia) is cleared by the defence.
82' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Venezia have a corner.
81' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
81' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) sends a low pass into the box, towards Christian Pulisic. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
80' Ridgeciano Haps goes off the pitch and Francesco Zampano (Venezia) comes on.
77' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
76' 11:10 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
75' A fine solo run by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.
74' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
72' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
71' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) comes close to scoring! He meets a lovely lofted pass from Ruben Loftus-Cheek, but sends his close-range header way wide of the left post.
71' Alejandro Jimenez has picked up an injury and is replaced by Kyle Walker (AC Milan).
70' Substitution. Rafael Leao makes way for Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
70' The injury to Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
67' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) comes onto the pitch because Cheick Conde simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
66' Cheick Conde (Venezia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Sergio Conceicao prepares a substitution. Tammy Abraham is replaced by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
64' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) is brought on as a substitute for Joel Schingtienne.
64' Here is a change. Daniel Fila is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
64' It is time for a substitution. Kike Perez (Venezia) is on for Gianluca Busio.
62' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
61' Cheick Conde (Venezia) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul. AC Milan earn a free kick.
59' John Yeboah (Venezia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
58' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
57' PENALTY APPEAL after John Yeboah (Venezia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
55' Fali Cande (Venezia) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
54' Fali Cande (Venezia) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
54' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
50' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mike Maignan scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
49' John Yeboah (Venezia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
48' John Yeboah (Venezia) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the roof of the net.
45+2' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Venezia.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A pass from John Yeboah (Venezia) is intercepted by Mike Maignan and the move breaks down.
43' A goal, which was scored by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), was disallowed due to offside.

42' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
39' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Venezia due to an offside in the build-up play.
35' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Venezia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
34' It's in the back of the net! Ridgeciano Haps slips the ball through to John Yeboah (Venezia), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
32' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post.

31' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Venezia have a free kick from a promising distance.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:3. 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
26' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
25' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
24' John Yeboah (Venezia) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
24' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) prepares to take a corner kick.

23' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Venezia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
23' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Venezia have been awarded a free kick.
22' John Yeboah plays a lovely pass into Alessio Zerbin (Venezia), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
19' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' Cheick Conde (Venezia) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. AC Milan are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
18' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike. The ball possession at the moment is 39:61.
16' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Tammy Abraham.
14' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) offside.
13' The resulting corner from Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) comes to nothing.
12' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Venezia.
12' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Manganiello signals. Free kick. Venezia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
10' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) and Youssouf Fofana try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
7' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) receives the ball from Gianluca Busio and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.

5' 0 - 1 Goal! Youssouf Fofana displays great vision and sends a pass to Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
4' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rafael Leao (AC Milan) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
3' Fali Cande (Venezia) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
3' John Yeboah (Venezia) is about to take a corner kick.
2' A cross into the box from Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Venezia are going to take it.
1' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) plays a long ball to Tijjani Reijnders, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Gianluca Manganiello is the one to supervise the game today.
